summary.text: Tricia Mayumi Kwai Lin Nakamatsu is the Democratic candidate for Hawaii State Senate District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Wallyn Kanoelani Christian; she won a five-candidate Democratic primary on August 8, 2026.

sources.title: Tricia Mayumi Kwai Lin Nakamatsu - Ballotpedia
